title: Sardinian elders dug up giant bones with jewellery

tellings.quote: I interviewed dozens of people in Sardinia who who had dug up the bones of giants themselves with their hands.

plain: Older people on the Italian island of Sardinia say that in the mid-1900s they dug up, with their own hands, the bones of giants buried with jewellery, which would mean a race of giant humans once lived there. The researcher Tim Alberino tells Michels he interviewed "dozens of people in Sardinia" who had done this themselves, work he connects to his film True Legends.
